MixAI logo motion

One definition (brand/src/motion.mjs) generates CSS, animated SVG, Android AnimatedVectorDrawable and SwiftUI. Every animation starts and ends on the static mark. This page uses the generated CSS.

Play

Static mark.

The family

Splash to first screen

First screen

Android: the system splash plays intro (AnimatedVectorDrawable, 900 ms), then the app plays morph on its first frame. iOS and tvOS: the launch screen is the static mark; the app starts intro from the identical first frame. Android TV has no splash animation: the app plays intro itself.

Sonic signature (candidates)

Two tones, the sources, become one tone, the signal. Synthesised from brand/src/sonic.mjs (no samples), peak -6 dBFS. Plays once at start on the TV apps, with a setting to turn it off.

Storyboard

intro 900 ms

Launch. The sources flow into the signal and come back out.

loading 1400 ms, loops

Working. The signal breathes, the sources dim in turn.

success 320 ms

Done. One beat of the signal.

error 180 ms

Failed. A short sideways shake (shape, not colour).

morph 420 ms

Splash to first screen. The sources fade, the signal grows over the screen.
